description: gzapp.decks's GZCoord integration: the brand's source of authority has one role, brand-comms, and it is on the fleet's coordination channel with the consumers it announces copies to (web-dev, the decks, the site) — the same relay and channel as every other project of the fleet, hosted on the coordinator's workspace. Read by gzcoord-inbox when the working copy resolves to project gzapp.decks; CLAUDE_BRIDGE_URL and GZCOORD_CHANNEL in the environment override it. No token_env_file: the account's token arrives with fabric-secrets sync. relay_runtime_dir is relative to the workspace, never inside a repository. Written 2026-09-17 at brand-comms's report that gzcoord-send refused from the decks clone (seq 856).
